name: bandit.r009_m097_choose_destination_route_mcw
description: R-009 M097 resolves the current executable's ordinary overmap travel input through CHOOSE_DESTINATION: the production-created player at (162,36,0) previews and confirms the nonempty route to (163,36,0) with keyboard-character W, then saves, reloads, and audits the arrived OMT before any camp setup.  On relaunch, the harness waits for the remote bridge to identify the new PID's window, reacquires local focus, and rejects a changed window identity before HUD proof or any post-relaunch input.

steps.label: dismiss_inherited_actions_overlay
steps.expected_visible_fact: the inherited Actions overlay is dismissed to the ordinary gameplay HUD
steps.abort_reason: the copied bootstrap did not dismiss its inherited Actions overlay into ordinary gameplay

steps.label: post_load_preopportunity_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the copied production-created bootstrap is a locally focused ordinary gameplay HUD
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created bootstrap save did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: open_overmap_for_ordinary_route
steps.expected_visible_fact: the standard overmap is open before selecting the ordinary destination

steps.label: move_overmap_cursor_to_163_36
steps.expected_visible_fact: ordinary overmap cursor movement selects absolute OMT (163,36,0)

steps.label: preview_ordinary_route_to_163_36
steps.expected_visible_fact: the keybinding owner's keyboard-character W previews the efficient ordinary route

steps.label: audit_choose_destination_route_preview
steps.abort_reason: the current executable did not resolve keyboard-character W to CHOOSE_DESTINATION and construct a nonempty route to (163,36,0)

steps.label: confirm_ordinary_route_to_163_36
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same W binding advances the previewed ordinary route to native confirmation

steps.label: accept_ordinary_route_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native travel confirmation accepts the nonempty ordinary route

steps.label: audit_choose_destination_route_confirmation
steps.abort_reason: the nonempty CHOOSE_DESTINATION route did not receive a successful native travel confirmation

steps.label: post_travel_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the confirmed ordinary route returns to the gameplay HUD before native save
steps.abort_reason: the confirmed ordinary route did not return to gameplay before save

steps.label: audit_player_save_before_route_arrival_save
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created save was absent before preserving the ordinary arrival

steps.label: open_native_full_save_after_route_arrival
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Save-and-Quit confirmation is visibly open after ordinary travel
steps.abort_reason: the normal Save-and-Quit confirmation was not visibly open after ordinary travel

steps.label: confirm_native_full_save_after_route_arrival
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Save-and-Quit action changes the player save after ordinary travel

steps.label: audit_player_save_after_route_arrival_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit action did not preserve the confirmed ordinary arrival

steps.label: open_native_main_menu_quit_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native main-menu quit confirmation is visibly open after saving the ordinary arrival
steps.abort_reason: Save-and-Quit did not return to the native main menu's quit confirmation

steps.label: confirm_native_process_exit_after_route_arrival
steps.expected_visible_fact: the original route-arrival process exits before the saved player reloads

steps.label: post_route_arrival_reload_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved player reloads to a green ordinary gameplay HUD after the original process exits
steps.abort_reason: the native route-arrival save did not reload into gameplay before camp creation

steps.label: post_travel_player_omt
steps.abort_reason: ordinary travel did not persist the player at (163,36,0) before camp creation

evidence_contract.claim: the current executable resolves W as CHOOSE_DESTINATION, constructs and confirms a nonempty ordinary route to (163,36,0), and preserves the arrival through native save/reload before any camp creation
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the harness copies a production-created save with save_transforms=[] and sends only normal overmap movement, the keybinding owner's keyboard-character W route commands, native confirmation, and native save/reload
evidence_contract.terminal: this route is a gate only: it creates no follower, camp, hostile state, report, decision, operation, drive, or eligibility evidence
